page.overview:
Who is Apoqliphort Towers?

Apoqliphort Towers is a character version of the card "Apoqliphort Towers".

It appears as an opponent in Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Arena, as the boss of Stage 13 under Quest mode. Defeating it for the first time as an opponent earns the player 50,000 Duel Points.
